title: fs.write
description: Write UTF-8 content to a file. Tier 1 (execute directly) when path is under $HOME AND not in a sensitive subdir (.ssh, .aws, .gnupg, .config/secrets). Otherwise Tier 3: returns requires_cow_approval and Phase 3's COW commit pipe carries the write through to the kernel.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to write.

content.description: UTF-8 content to write. Binary writes land in Phase 5.

mode.description: POSIX permissions (octal as decimal). Defaults to 0o644 (420) when omitted.
